reasons: The task card asks only for the desk's annualized volatility. It specifies no estimation window, horizon, sample or confidence level.
The repair changed only the rolling window, from 60 to 20. The original 60-day window was impossible with 40 returns, and it was a choice of the original call, not a requirement on the card.
The returns series, the annualization factor (252) and the method (rolling_volatility) are unchanged, so the result is still an annualized volatility of the same desk's returns.

The gate confirms 21 complete windows and an independent recomputation of the last window. The reported 0.118 is plausible for daily returns with roughly 0.007 standard deviation annualized by sqrt(252).
